correctness.rationale: A generic plane cuts a polytope edge exactly when its endpoints have opposite signs. At a midpoint x the four neighbors are exactly the midpoint pairs in the two incident original triangles: each midpoint triangle is an exposed facet of the rectification, so its sides are edges. The balance equation makes the four neighbor projections onto x-perp cancel in two opposite pairs. At a simple wall there are two positive and two negative neighbors and no jump in crossing count. The general criterion's origin-interiority step can be supplied as follows. The exposed triangles in distinct facet planes give a full-dimensional rectification. If the origin were not interior, there would be a supporting plane through it touching a nonzero midpoint vertex (for exterior origin vary a strictly separating normal continuously to its opposite until the minimum projection is zero; at a boundary vertex choose an incident facet). At any nonzero touching vertex the neighbor sum is parallel to that vertex; nonnegativity makes all its neighbors touch. The polytope graph remains connected on deletion of at most the vertex 0, so all vertices would lie in the plane, a contradiction. Consequently simultaneous switching vertices are opposite radial endpoints and are nonadjacent, so their zero jumps add. The regular originals have balanced diamonds by their edge-axis half-turns. Independent exact base-direction enumeration for normal (1,2,4) found no midpoint ties. Enumerating original triangles as triples with all squared distances 2 for the octahedron or 4 for the icosahedron gives counts by number of positive midpoint signs of (2,2,2,2) and (7,3,3,7); each mixed triangle contributes two crossed edges, giving 8 and 12. For replay, sign a midpoint by n·(u+v), comparing the signs of 2a+b and b and then (2a+b)² with 5b² for a+bφ. Each cut edge separates the two distinct face types, forcing alternation and therefore the stated face counts. Central symmetry, measure-zero exceptions and affine invariance follow with the stipulated centers and vertex avoidance.
residual_risks: The checker docstring names checker.py rather than its supplied path checks/verify.py. Finite direction samples are not the invariance proof. No assertion is made for planes containing vertices or offset planes.
